description:
The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB). 

This scheme was introduced to provide financial assistance to the daughters of construction workers. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on families when it comes to marriage expenses. 

It was officially launched on 1st April 2017. 

The primary objective of the Marriage Assistance Scheme is to provide a one-time financial grant to eligible beneficiaries. 

The scheme specifically targets the daughters of registered construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. 

The assistance amount provided under this scheme is ₹51,000. 

This amount is intended to help cover various expenses related to marriage. 

The scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and their families. 

It also seeks to encourage the education and empowerment of women by supporting their marriage. 

To be eligible for the Marriage Assistance Scheme, applicants must meet certain criteria. 

The applicant must be a daughter of a registered construction worker. 

The construction worker must be registered with the MPBOCWWB. 

The applicant must be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage. 

There is no upper age limit specified for the applicant. 

The family income of the construction worker should not exceed ₹8,000 per month. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches those who are in genuine need. 

The application process for the Marriage Assistance Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available at the MPBOCWWB offices. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the MPBOCWWB. 

Applicants must provide proof of their father's registration with the board. 

A copy of the marriage invitation card must be submitted along with the application. 

Proof of age for the applicant is also required. 

This can be provided through documents such as a birth certificate or school leaving certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must submit an affidavit declaring their family income. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the nearest MPBOCWWB office. 

The applications are reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of the financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme has a defined timeline for processing applications. 

Applications can be submitted throughout the year. 

However, it is advisable to apply at least three months before the planned marriage date. 

This allows sufficient time for processing and disbursement of funds. 

The MPBOCWWB is responsible for implementing the scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour, Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

Contact details for the MPBOCWWB can be found on their official website. 

The board's office can be reached for any inquiries regarding the scheme. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme has been beneficial for many families in Madhya Pradesh. 

Since its launch, thousands of daughters of construction workers have received financial assistance. 

This has helped ease the financial burden of marriage expenses. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Madhya Pradesh government to support marginalized communities. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the socio-economic conditions of construction workers. 

The assistance provided under this scheme is a significant amount for low-income families. 

It helps in promoting gender equity by supporting the marriage of daughters. 

The scheme also encourages families to invest in the education and well-being of their daughters. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is regularly monitored for its effectiveness. 

Feedback is collected from beneficiaries to improve the scheme. 

The government aims to enhance the reach of the scheme to ensure more families benefit. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform eligible families about the scheme. 

These campaigns are crucial for maximizing participation and ensuring that the intended beneficiaries are reached. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a vital component of the welfare initiatives in Madhya Pradesh. 

It aligns with the government's broader goals of social welfare and empowerment. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's focus on supporting the construction worker community. 

By providing financial assistance for marriage, the scheme helps in reducing the financial stress on families. 

Overall, the Marriage Assistance Scheme is a significant step towards improving the quality of life for construction workers and their families in Madhya Pradesh. 

It not only provides financial support but also promotes the dignity and empowerment of women in society. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's commitment to social justice and equality. 

The ongoing success of the scheme will depend on continued awareness and accessibility for eligible families. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme represents a proactive approach to addressing the challenges faced by construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. 

It is an essential program that contributes to the overall welfare of the community. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is a critical resource for many families. 

It enables them to celebrate marriages without the burden of excessive debt. 

The scheme is an example of how targeted welfare initiatives can make a tangible difference in people's lives. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a model that could inspire similar initiatives in other states. 

It highlights the importance of government support in facilitating social and economic development. 

The scheme continues to evolve to meet the needs of the community it serves. 

The Madhya Pradesh government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of construction workers through such initiatives. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a vital part of this ongoing effort.
